name: Depco Power Systems
old_description: Depco Power Systems distributes switchgear for defense, mining, telecommunications and oil & gas industries. Switchgear units meet military specifications and are used in power generation and standby applications.
about:
Depco Power Systems is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The company was founded in January 1991 by Tim Felty and Dick Davis in Alvin, Texas, originally operating as Diesel Engine & Parts Co. Tadd Stickler joined the team later that year, becoming a key contributor to the company's growth. In 1993, the business moved to its current 30,000-square-foot facility on Hillsboro Street in Houston, positioned near the Port of Houston.

Depco buys, sells, and rebuilds power generation equipment, including diesel and natural gas generator sets, generator ends (100 kW to 3,000 kW), marine engines and transmissions, power units, transfer switches, radiators, and miscellaneous parts. The Houston facility spans an entire city block and is equipped with a loading dock, forklifts, and three overhead cranes for handling large power units. A multi-step testing and certification process is applied to each unit, and the company maintains a staff of 10 to 49 employees. Depco also offers global shipping, with a proven track record of overnight delivery.

The company serves a range of industries: defense, mining, telecommunications, oil and gas, marine and offshore, data centers, healthcare (hospitals), cryptocurrency mining, grow rooms, and dredging. Customers include commercial and industrial buyers seeking standby, prime, or backup power solutions, as well as sellers of used equipment looking for quick settlement and fair market value.

Depco emphasizes its purpose-built facility, rigorous testing, and responsive in-house service team as differentiators. The Depco Guarantee provides warranty support on certified units, backed by flexible payment terms and 35-plus years of industry expertise. The founders' early focus on supplying used Detroit Diesel parts to dealers nationwide established a conservative, quality-oriented approach that continues to shape the company's operations.
